task: Phase 8 PART A -- Daily Queue Generation Fix, architecture design

architecture_questions.3_what_completes_a_queue_item: search_worker._finalize_queue_item(), called unconditionally at the end of process_queue_item() including every early-failure path -- sets status to COMPLETED/PARTIAL/BLOCKED/FAILED
architecture_questions.4_what_happens_after_exhaustion: claim_next_queue_item() finds nothing QUEUED, run_once() breaks immediately, prints 'No eligible QUEUED work found' -- safe, non-destructive. BEFORE this fix, nothing recreated a new item.
architecture_questions.5_one_shot_or_recurring: one-shot per submission by design -- not a defect in search_submission.py/search_worker.py; the gap was that nothing else in the chain called submit_search() recurringly
architecture_questions.6_existing_safe_submission_function: search_submission.submit_search(), already built, already tested (25 tests in test_search_submission.py), already exposed via scripts/submit_search.py
architecture_questions.7_can_be_made_idempotent: already is and always was -- submit_search()'s existing fingerprint-based duplicate-submission policy, proven by pre-existing test_search_submission.py test 20 and re-proven end-to-end by this phase's test_phase8_daily_queue.py

architecture_before: launchd -> run_daily_search.sh -> run_search_worker.py --once (ONLY consumes, never produces; queue exhausted after first successful run, forever)
architecture_after: launchd -> run_daily_search.sh -> submit_search.py --candidate-id saroj --max-job-age-days 3 --confirm (existing, unmodified, already-idempotent submit_search()) -> run_search_worker.py --once -> generate_run_report.py (existing) -> run_summary.json (existing)

fix.submit_search_py_change: added one new optional flag --max-job-age-days N, passed through to the existing submit_search() parameter of the same name
fix.run_daily_search_sh_change: added one call to submit_search.py --candidate-id saroj --max-job-age-days 3 --confirm immediately before the existing run_search_worker.py --once call
fix.reason_sources_not_hardcoded: omitted, letting submit_search()'s own default (search_profile._default_sources(), every ENABLED adapter) resolve dynamically -- Hirist/LinkedIn automatically included the moment they are actually enabled, zero further code change needed
fix.reason: worker step is always safe to attempt regardless; failure is logged, not fatal to the overall run

queue_safety_requirements.idempotent: inherited from submit_search()'s existing fingerprint policy, re-proven end-to-end
queue_safety_requirements.candidate_scoped: candidate_id always explicit and required, confirmed by test_search_submission.py test 23 and Phase 8 test 5
queue_safety_requirements.source_aware: sources=None resolves to _default_sources() (ENABLED-only), confirmed by Phase 8 test 6 via safe registry isolation
queue_safety_requirements.snapshot_aware: search_runs.query freezes the exact query plan at submission time (pre-existing, unchanged), confirmed deterministic by Phase 8 test 7
queue_safety_requirements.safe_for_repeated_daily_execution: confirmed by Phase 8 PART C's full RUN 1/RUN 2/next-day cycle test
queue_safety_requirements.compatible_with_duplicate_policy: not reimplemented -- the existing policy IS the mechanism used
queue_safety_requirements.compatible_with_existing_semantics: no schema or state-machine change of any kind

historical_data_untouched.mechanism: submit_search() only ever INSERTs new rows; nothing in this fix ever UPDATEs or DELETEs an existing jobs/candidate_job_matches/search_runs row

see_also: data/reports/phase8_multisource_validation.md -- full Phase 8 results, including one disclosed safety deviation caught and fixed before this design was finalized
